stages.name: Full-Duplex Dual WebSocket Handshake
stages.details: Client & Device connected simultaneously. Roundtrip ping/pong confirmed.

stages.name: Closed-Loop Autonomous Optical Tracking
stages.details: Target acquired (ID 1). PID dispatched cmd.servo.move (Pan: 92.9°, Tilt: 88.0°).

stages.name: Manual D-Pad Jog & Speed Scaling
stages.details: Arbitrated manual jog received: Pan 125.0°, Tilt 75.0° at speed factor 0.6.

stages.name: Ultrasonic Hazard (<20cm) Interlock
stages.details: Proximity obstruction alert generated (Obstacle detected 14.5 cm from camera (Threshold: 20.0 cm). Servo motion inhibited.).

stages.name: HC-SR501 PIR Intrusion Motion Alert
stages.details: Motion alarm event broadcast to operators upon pyroelectric rising edge.

stages.name: Communication Loss & Safe-Stop Failsafe
stages.details: Gateway asserted FAILSAFE_ACTIVE upon WebSocket disconnect. Servos locked.

stages.name: Link Recovery & Neutral Re-Centering
stages.details: Connection restored. Calibration center command delivered (Pan 90°, Tilt 90°).
